about: One table of cases for the rule that tells a gated motion proof from an exploration (try-out) proof and from a gone one: motion_proof_kind in scripts/lib/_common.py and motionProofKind in scripts/lib/_common.mjs must answer every row the same (tests/test_qa_infra.py and tests/node/common.test.mjs read this file). `files` are the project files that exist, `kind` the answer.

cases.why: a proof of the project
a proof at the top of the project
a report that names no proof is gated
an empty name is no proof either
the file is not there
a folder is not a proof file
a try-out in a round
a try-out of one variant of a motion round
a try-out straight in rounds/
a frozen proof
a proof moved aside
a removed-* folder deeper down
a removed-* folder with a number
a gone try-out is gone first
a file called rounds.json is not a rounds/ folder
the last part is the file: a file named history is no folder
a file named removed-x is no folder either
rounds-copy is not rounds
a folder named removed is not removed-*
the names are case sensitive
a leading ./ is dropped
a doubled slash is dropped
a . in the middle is dropped
a .. is kept, as pathlib keeps it: the path still goes through rounds/
a .. is kept: a path that goes through motion/ first and then up and into rounds/
